verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the API Reference at /api/latest/ and its markdown version. The 'latest' path hints that versions exist, but nothing in the pack states an explicit version scheme or any deprecation policy. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths, so there is no machine-readable spec showing versions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of API versions (e.g., v1/v2), a documented deprecation policy and timelines, a published versioned OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
